sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. The Petitioner having been implicated in connection with Kegaon P.S. Case No.62 of 2015 corresponding to C.T. Case No.70/1 of 2018-19 (Sessions) arising out of C.T. Case No.365 of 2015 for alleged commission of offence under section- 489(B)/489(C)/420/120(B) of the IPC, pending on t h e f i l e o f l e a r n e d A d d i t i o n a l D i s t r i c t J u d g e - c u m - S p e c i a l J u d g e , V i g i l a n c e ,
Bhawanipatna-Kalahandi, has filed this application under section-438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail in the event of his arrest in the above mentioned case.

3. Heard learned Counsel for the Petitioner and learned Counsel for the State.
4.

Considering the submissions and viewing the materials on record as also other surrounding circumstances, while being not inclined to grant of anticipatory bail to the Petitioner, this application is disposed of with the observation that in the event the Petitioner surrenders before the Court in seisin of the aforesaid case within three weeks hence and moves for his release on bail, the same shall be considered on its own merit; further looking to the factum of acquittal of the co-accused persons in its proper perspective.
5. The ABLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.
